activities: Village tour with Sri Lankan cooking class & lunch
Pidurangala sunset OR Eco Park safari
itinerary.overnight: Overnight at Go Go Green – Habarana (with pool)

itinerary.title: Sigiriya & Polonnaruwa
itinerary.description: Full day exploring two UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
activities: Ancient City of Polonnaruwa (by bicycle or tuk-tuk)
itinerary.overnight: Overnight at Go Go Green – Habarana (with pool)

itinerary.title: Habarana to Kandy
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to the cultural capital.
activities: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
itinerary.overnight: Overnight at Jack Tree Lodge – Kandy

itinerary.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Into the cool hill country.
itinerary.overnight: Overnight at Lu Chalet – Nuwara Eliya

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya Exploration
itinerary.description: Relax and discover 'Little England'.
itinerary.overnight: Overnight at Lu Chalet – Nuwara Eliya

itinerary.title: Horton Plains & Ella
itinerary.description: World-famous scenic train ride.
activities: Horton Plains National Park & World's End (early morning)
Scenic train Nanu Oya → Ella (Blue Train)
itinerary.overnight: Overnight at Ella River Front – Ella

itinerary.title: Ella Exploration
itinerary.description: Full day enjoying Ella's viewpoints.
itinerary.overnight: Overnight at Ella River Front – Ella

itinerary.title: Ella to Yala
itinerary.description: Wildlife adventure in the south.
activities: Afternoon safari in Yala National Park

itinerary.title: Yala to Mirissa / Hikkaduwa
itinerary.description: Coastal relaxation begins.
itinerary.overnight: Overnight at N34 – Mirissa OR Finlanka Hotel – Hikkaduwa (with pool)

itinerary.title: Beach to Colombo / Departure
itinerary.description:
Final highlights and airport transfer.

**Drop-off at Bandaranaike International Airport or Colombo hotel**
activities: Madu River boat safari (if from Hikkaduwa)
Colombo city highlights: Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Square, Galle Face Green
